package.name: brainco_stark_sdk_vendor
package.description: Vendor package for the BrainCo Stark SDK (bc-stark-sdk). The SDK ships as a prebuilt binary drop, never as source, so this package downloads the release zip at build time and installs the headers and shared library into the colcon install tree. Downstream packages get it via find_package, not via a hardcoded path into someone's source directory.
